response.justification: The candidate is a versatile senior engineer with genuine geospatial experience (founder of GISCollective, Green Map GIS work, FOSS4G talk) and proven low-latency systems work in DLang handling millions of requests per second. However, his professional C++ experience is limited and dated (2014–2015), he has no Rust, and there is no direct routing, navigation guidance, or map-tiling pipeline experience. Recent work is predominantly TypeScript/Node.js product engineering, which diverges from the C++-centric systems role. He may be worth a conversation if the team values geospatial domain familiarity and adaptability, but he is not a strong direct match.
strengths: Hands-on geospatial/GIS platform experience as founder of GISCollective and Green Map contributor
Low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (DLang microservices at millions of HTTP requests/sec)
Strong engineering culture: TDD, CI/CD, testing tools authorship, Linux and Docker proficiency
concerns: Minimal and outdated professional C++ (2014–2015); no Rust experience
No routing, navigation guidance, or map-tile pipeline background
Recent years focused on TypeScript/Node full-stack product work, not systems programming
